name: Chresten Nielsen — additional daughter Birte (b. 1805)
researcher_question: Did Chresten Nielsen and his wife Birte Kirstine Sørensdatter of Tyrsted, Vejle, Denmark have a daughter named Birte, born 1805, in addition to their nine known children (b. 1791-1801)?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples.csv row 13, flag adds_daughter, confidence 3). Resolved true match, re-adjudicated under issue #1346: the originally-cited christening ark (W6M7-SWMM) was fabricated (an unrelated US WWI draft card) and has been removed. Parentage is corroborated by the 1819 confirmation record (ark QG8V-2DDT, birth year only); the 3 Aug 1805 Dallerup birth date/place is sourced to the original 1805 Dallerup church book (DGS 007226375, image 00232, cited by image ID — volume not full-text indexed).
